title: Custom Furniture in Bratislava & Vienna | DUMSKAYA DESIGN
description: Design and production of custom furniture: kitchens, wardrobes, walk-in closets, hallways and studies. Measuring, manufacturing and installation.
h1: Design and manufacturing of custom furniture for residential properties

blocks.text: Design and manufacturing of custom furniture for residential properties

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) offers the design and manufacturing of custom cabinet furniture for apartments, condos, and private homes.

More than 15 years of experience in custom furniture manufacturing enables us to create bespoke solutions that precisely match the interior architecture, the room dimensions, the functional requirements, and the aesthetic preferences of each client.

We see furniture as an integral part of interior architecture. That is why kitchens, wardrobes, walk-in closets, entrance halls, home offices, storage systems, and other elements are designed in the same style as the space.
Our furniture is manufactured in Slovakia, and a professional team delivers and installs the finished pieces at clients’ sites in countries around the world.
Custom kitchens We design bespoke kitchens tailored to the room’s dimensions, layout, ergonomics, utility line locations, and the overall interior concept.
Each kitchen is developed specifically for the project at hand — from the configuration of the cabinets and work surfaces to the interior fittings, materials, hardware, and integrated lighting.
At the client’s request, the kitchen can be fitted with Miele appliances through our partnership with the brand.
Custom built-in wardrobes Built-in wardrobes make the most of the available space and visually integrate storage into the interior architecture.
We design wardrobes to custom dimensions, taking into account the required storage capacity, interior fittings, opening mechanisms, materials, and front design.
Wardrobes can be an almost invisible part of the interior or, on the contrary, a striking decorative feature of the space.
Entrance halls and walk-in closets We design custom entrance hall furniture and walk-in closet systems for convenient storage of clothing, shoes, and accessories.
We plan the placement of shelves, drawers, hanging rails, pull-out elements, lighting, and other functional components.
Each storage system is adapted to the dimensions of the room and the individual needs of its owners.
Home office furniture For home offices, we design ergonomic desks, cabinets, shelving units, storage systems, and built-in furniture compositions.
We pay special attention to workspace organization, convenient storage for documents and equipment, lighting, and integrating the furniture into the overall interior of the apartment or house.
Custom furniture for residential interiors In addition to kitchens, wardrobes, and walk-in closets, DUMSKAYA DESIGN designs custom furniture solutions for various rooms throughout the home.
These may include:
— living room furniture;
— TV areas and wall panels;
— bedroom furniture;
— nightstands and dressers;
— home libraries;
— children’s room furniture;
— workstations;
— built-in storage systems;
— decorative furniture structures.
Each element is designed with the room’s architecture and the overall interior concept in mind.
Custom furniture design Work on the furniture begins with an analysis of the room, its dimensions, its architecture, and the client’s goals.
We develop the furniture’s construction and determine its dimensions, proportions, materials, interior fittings, hardware, opening mechanisms, and decorative details.
If needed, we prepare the detailed technical drawings and specifications required for production.
Materials and hardware We select materials and components for furniture manufacturing based on the design, functionality, operating conditions, and project budget.
We pay special attention to the quality of the fronts, carcasses, countertops, hardware, opening mechanisms, and interior fittings.
Modern manufacturing technologies allow us to create custom furniture with complex geometry, integrated lighting, and meticulously crafted details.

Furniture as part of interior design One of the main advantages of a comprehensive collaboration with DUMSKAYA DESIGN is the ability to develop the interior and the custom furniture at the same time. This makes it possible to define the size and placement of every element in advance and to coordinate materials, colors, lighting, and architectural details.
As a result, the furniture becomes a natural extension of the interior rather than a separate element added after the design project is complete.

Manufacturing, delivery, and installation Once the design is approved, the furniture goes into production. DUMSKAYA DESIGN’s production facility is located in Slovakia. After manufacturing, we can arrange delivery and professional installation of the furniture at the client’s site. Our installation team works on projects in various countries, which allows us to bring our furniture solutions to life not only in Slovakia and Austria but also at other international locations.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) — more than 15 years of experience in designing and manufacturing custom furniture for apartments and private homes.
